news.title: $1.9 Million Federal Award Backs Michigan Tech’s Role in National Cybersecurity
news.summary_en: The U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) has awarded Michigan Technological University $1.9 million to educate and mentor the next generation of national cybersecurity and artificial intelligence professionals.
